# Untold.works

> Boutique AI agency based in Mexico City and San Miguel de Allende, Mexico. We build AI-powered business ecosystems — brand identity, websites, AI workflows, and automated business systems — for companies across Mexico and the United States. Bilingual (English/Spanish). Founded on storytelling and creative direction, powered by AI.

Untold.works is a boutique agency that combines brand strategy, web development, and AI-powered business systems into complete ecosystems. We serve solo professionals, small businesses, and enterprise teams. Every project starts with brand and ends with a fully documented, fully trained handoff. We specialize in the Mexico and US markets, with deep roots in Mexico City and San Miguel de Allende.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://untold.works/): AI-powered business ecosystems. Brand, website, AI systems, workflows — built mobile-first.
- [About](https://untold.works/about): Storytellers first, technologists second. Our team, philosophy, and why we're based in Mexico.
- [Contact](https://untold.works/contact): Start a conversation. Based in Mexico City and San Miguel de Allende, serving Mexico and the US.
- [Portfolio](https://untold.works/portfolio): Case studies of AI-powered ecosystems built for real businesses.
- [Blog](https://untold.works/blog): Practical guides on AI tools, business systems, and brand strategy.
- [Workshops](https://untold.works/workshops): AI workshops in San Miguel de Allende. Practical AI for everyday life and small business.

## Solutions

- [Professional Services](https://untold.works/solutions/professional-services): Complete AI-powered business systems for doctors, lawyers, consultants, architects, and service professionals.
- [Small Business Platforms](https://untold.works/solutions/small-business): Integrated AI systems for restaurants, hotels, retail, and growing teams.
- [Enterprise & Operations](https://untold.works/solutions/enterprise): AI infrastructure for complex operations — multi-team CRM, automation, revenue operations.
